ABOUT AAA RV

Craftsmanship
at our core.

A local RV repair shop with roots in fiberglass work and a focus on the details that matter.

OUR ROOTS · AAA FIBERGLASS

OUR STORY

From fiberglass repair
to complete RV care.

AAA’s story began with fiberglass work and the Kringlen family. What started as a small repair operation grew into a shop equipped for RV collision repairs, paint, restoration, and everyday service.

Today, AAA RV Collision & Service serves RV owners from our location at 10519 S. Sunnylane in Oklahoma City. We work on motorhomes, fifth wheels, and travel trailers, inside and out.

Our approach is straightforward: pay attention to the details, talk through the work, and take pride in the finished repair.

Explore what we do

WHAT MATTERS HERE

The details.
The workmanship.
The people.

From the structure underneath to the final finish, each part of a repair deserves attention. We offer a lifetime workmanship guarantee; ask our team about coverage for your specific repair.

Home / CLAIM HELP

CLAIM HELP

A repair plan.
A clearer next step.

If your RV has been damaged, start by gathering the details and calling our shop to discuss a damage evaluation.

GETTING STARTED

From the first call
to the repair.

  1. Gather your information

    Have your RV’s year, make, model, and VIN available, along with photos of the damage and any estimate already prepared.

  2. Contact your insurance company

    Report the incident and obtain your claim number and adjuster contact information. Ask your insurer about the next steps for your claim.

  3. Call AAA RV

    We will discuss your damage evaluation, repair plans, and appointment details. Your estimate is provided at no charge when AAA RV completes the approved repairs.

  4. Review the repair plan

    Our team can work with your adjuster on repair details. Coverage decisions belong to the insurer; repair authorization and scheduling are discussed with you.

Have these details ready.

  • Your name and contact number
  • RV year, make, model, and VIN
  • Insurance company and claim number
  • Adjuster name and contact information
  • Photos and existing repair estimates
  • Incident date and a description of the damage
YOUR ESTIMATE & REPAIRS

No estimate fee when AAA RV completes your approved repairs.

When AAA RV completes the repairs in your approved estimate, there is no estimate charge. If we prepare an estimate and you choose not to have those approved repairs completed at AAA RV, an estimate fee applies.

QUOTES & ESTIMATES

Our estimate
policy.

Know what to expect before you bring your RV in.

DAMAGE EVALUATIONS

Never pay for an estimate when you have your repairs done at AAA RV.

When AAA RV completes the repairs in your approved estimate, there is no estimate charge. If we prepare an estimate and you choose not to have those approved repairs completed at AAA RV, an estimate fee applies.

For example, an estimate fee applies if you choose to keep the repair funds or have the repairs completed elsewhere. Call us to discuss your plans and any applicable fee before your evaluation.

SERVICE & MAINTENANCE

Free quotes for service and maintenance.

Tell us the service or maintenance item you need. When an unknown issue requires troubleshooting, diagnostic labor may be necessary.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Before your visit.

Will I pay for an estimate if AAA RV repairs my RV?

No. When AAA RV completes the repairs in your approved estimate, there is no estimate charge.

When does an estimate fee apply?

An estimate fee applies if we prepare an estimate and you choose not to have the approved repairs completed at AAA RV, such as keeping the repair funds or having the work done elsewhere. Call us to discuss the applicable fee before your evaluation.

What qualifies for a free quote?

Free quotes are available for service and maintenance related items. Finding the cause of an unknown problem may require diagnostic labor.

Do I need to call before bringing my RV?

Please call the shop to arrange your appointment or drop-off and confirm what information to bring.

Do you work on motorhomes and towable RVs?

We work on motorhomes, fifth wheels, and travel trailers. Motorhome engine and transmission repairs are outside our service scope.

Can you help with an insurance repair?

Yes. Bring your claim number, adjuster contact information, and any estimate or photos you already have. We can discuss the evaluation and repair process with you.
